- When sentiment is high (≥ 0.65) over recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–2% for next period.
- After a sharp price spike (≥ 5% from prior peak), model often overshoots; cap forecast at +3% above prior peak for next 3 days.
- If sentiment is low (≤ 0.3) and price is trending down, model underestimates; add 0.5–1.5% to forecast to avoid premature bottoming.
- Model consistently underestimates in early 30d horizon when sentiment is mixed (0.3–0.6); apply +1% bias to first 5 forecast points.
- If last 3 sentiment values are 0.0 or 0.2, model shows lagged reaction; delay forecast adjustment by 1–2 days and apply +0.5% correction.
- Mean reversion bias: if 3 consecutive forecast values are > 1% above true, reduce by 0.5% per day until convergence.
- For 30d horizon, if true outcome exceeds forecast by > 2% for 2+ consecutive days, model is overconfident; reduce next forecast by 1.5–2.5%.
